bio: Gvantsa Mzareulishvili is a Georgian illustrator and graphic designer. Her world is a colourful one: confident young women in bold, patterned clothes, and the old courtyards and carved balconies of Tbilisi redrawn in candy pinks, lilacs and sky blues — drawn by hand, full of small details, flowers and sparkle. (Draft biography — to be completed with the artist.)
